{"consolidated_memory":"platform/config/loader.py - Wrong Environment in Config Loader (Multiple Occasions)

COMPONENT: platform/config/loader.py (Python)
TEST COVERAGE: tests/platform/test_config_loader.py

OCCASION 1: [2026-03-19]
Problem: Wrong environment in config loader
Repro: Boot service with unset profile variable
Signal: Production endpoint appearing in staging process
Trigger: Only on first request after cold start
Root Cause: Error swallowed by bare except clause
Fix: Narrowed the exception handler to allow failure to propagate (PR #2467 on branch fix/wrong-environment-1)
Result: Flaky test rate improved from 6 failures per 100 runs to zero

OCCASION 2: [2026-05-07]
Problem: Wrong environment in config loader
Repro: Boot service with unset profile variable
Signal: Production endpoint appearing in staging process
Trigger: Only for payloads above roughly two megabytes
Root Cause: Event listener registered but never removed on teardown
Fix: Removed listener during teardown and added assertion in test (PR #6644 on branch fix/wrong-environment-4)
Result: Error rate dropped from 4.2 percent to under 3 per 10,000 (0.03%)"}
